assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and transient visual disturbances concerning for transient cerebral ischemic attacks in the setting of known sick sinus syndrome
The procedure is ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias and assess the efficacy of current rate-control management
The service is consistent with the member's clinical indication
The service is supported by the documented diagnosis codes G45.9 and I49.5
The claim for Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) has been denied
The denial is based on Reason Code PR-204
The service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
Coverage limitations are defined by the contracted policy terms and this procedure falls outside those parameters
The patient has the right to file an appeal within ninety days of the notice
